name: APSP
description: A valid instance is an explicitly encoded attributed directed graph G=(V,E,w) with |V| ≤ n, non-negative integer edge weights satisfying 0 ≤ w(e) ≤ n^c, and total encoding size O(n^2) machine words. Parallel edges, self-loops, and disconnected graphs are allowed. For u,v ∈ V, let D_G(u,v) be the minimum total weight of a directed u-to-v path, with D_G(u,v)=+∞ if no such path exists.
